cs.t: If you don't mind sub-par call quality, the Bragi "The Headphone" headphones (yeah...) are absolutely incredible and are a worthy alternative to Apple AirPods while providing passive noise isolation. Great range, good sound quality (not as much bass as the AirPods), super duper comfortable, and looks amazing in your ears. The Dash Pro is the more advanced version of these headphones but reviews are mixed and $350 is a lot of money to gamble on headphones (for most of us). By "sub-par", I mean "people can hear you, mostly, until they start talking or you step outside/out of range." If that wasn't a problem, I'd still be wearing mine. Absolutely loved the product.
